title: Holds on Payout Methods
content:
A hold on Payout Methods stops transfers without touching the balance: the undisbursed balance stays as it is while the hold is open. Holds are documentary records on the payout ledger, each placed with its reason and released by a record naming it.

## The four holds

| Hold reason | Placed on | Runs for | Released |
|---|---|---|---|
| Account suspension | Every method of the host account, when the host account is suspended | While the account stays suspended | On the day the host account is reinstated; only when the host account's status is active again; never while the account stays suspended |
| New method | The newly verified method | The rail's new-method hold period in calendar days after verification | When that period has run |
| Default change | The new default method | The default-change security hold, 72 elapsed hours after the moment the method became the default | When those hours have run |
| Risk review | The method, placed by Roamhaven's risk team | 5 business days | After 5 business days, unless the risk team extends it |

## The release condition for an account-suspension hold

An account-suspension hold is released only when the host account's status is active again. The host account's status on its own record is the evidence. An account that is still suspended, or whose status is restricted or deactivated, does not meet this condition.

## Open holds

A hold is open when the payout ledger shows it placed and shows no release naming it. For an account-suspension hold, a hold placed on any method of the account counts.

## Hypothetical cases

- An imagined host account is suspended on 2026-01-08; an account-suspension hold is placed on each of its three methods. On 2026-02-20 the account is reinstated and its status is active again: the three holds are released that day.
- An imagined host sets a new default at 09:00 on 2026-04-01. Transfers to that method are held until 09:00 on 2026-04-04, when 72 elapsed hours have run.
- An imagined risk-review hold placed by the risk team is released once it has lasted 5 business days; where the risk team extends it, it is not released at that point.
